_help: Family nicknames and funny notes. Keep these spoiler-free! They show no matter which episode someone is on.

Aaliyah Puglia.note: Chef from Providence and the only castaway nobody in this family drafted. Cooking for 20 strangers on rice and vibes.

Alexis Levine.note: Criminal defense attorney who's used to being "on the bottom." Spends all day defending the little guy from the government. Now she has to defend herself from 20 strangers and Jeff Probst.

Ana Sani.note: Honors poli-sci grad who studies why people in power do what they do. Firmly anti transition lenses. Get all the way into the subway car, please.

Brady Booker.note: Pro wrestler and secret former gymnast. Pet peeve is bad hygiene, which makes this a bold choice of vacation.

Carter Krull.note: Livestock farmer who opened a snow cone truck to "get in a tropical mood." Co-founded a moving company called MOVE MOVE MOVE. Chew with your mouth open and you're going home.

Cristian Chavez.note: Head of HR with a "very LOUD laugh" and a strong aversion to worms. The island is mostly worms. HR will be hearing about this.

Danny Kilby.note: Board game designer whose "whole life has been training for today." Do NOT tell him wrestling is fake.

Devin Way.note: Kid #7 of 13 siblings and a weekly Dungeons & Dragons player. He's been rolling for initiative in family drama his entire life.

Eric Macksoud.note: Mental health counselor, theater kid and (surprise) Muay Thai trained. Will correct your grammar, then your emotional intelligence.

Jelly Loblack.note: Sociology professor who once won Most Comedic Mascot at mascot camp as Webber the Bear. Mascot camp is real. She is studying all of you.

Jenna Doore.note: Wedding photographer who slipped a "Survivor Clause" into five years of wedding contracts. Family nickname: NENERGY.

Kristin Flickinger.note: Crisis management pro who carries rocks in her bra "for protection." Thinks "pet peeve" sounds like a poltergeist dog. Crumbs on the counter are a crisis.

Lewis Kelly.note: Vacationed in North Korea for fun. Insists every public blunder is "very thought out and deliberately executed." Sure, Lewis.

Linnea Capobianco.note: Entrepreneur with a documented laughing problem: funerals, church, presentations. Tribal Council is a minefield. Do not ask her zodiac sign.

Maggie Nestor.note: Self-described "joyful, intentional, redneck." Mom of three, so Tribal Council is just bedtime negotiations with more torches.

Mike Pinsky.note: Yankees exec who's scouted players from a comfy chair for years and finally wants to be on the field. Pet peeves: misused words, overused words, and under-seasoned food. Good luck with the rice.

Ori Jean-Charles.note: Broke an NCAA D1 record while driving 8 hours home every weekend until his Audi literally blew up. Also first chair violin in 6th grade. Range.

Patt Cannaday.note: Federal prosecutor whose parents have never once yelled at him. Pet peeve: white sunglasses with flip flops and jeans. The fashion police are in session.

Rob Antonson.note: Airline gate agent and certified reality TV junkie. Says Survivor chaos is "just another busy Friday at the airport."

Sharonda Cox.note: OBGYN resident who played violin at Disney and loves NASA. Cannot stand loud chewers. Somebody keep her away from Carter's snack time.

Thien An Nguyen.note: Back-to-back all-around intramural champ (she'd like you to know). Will judge your your/you're. Former Boy Scout, yes Boy Scout.
